comments.148:
Released in [@emseepea/feedback 0.8.2](https://github.com/emseepea/emseepea/releases/tag/%40emseepea%2Ffeedback%400.8.2).

Collection submissions, conversation tools, and operator reads now explicitly advertise `destructiveHint: false`. Existing read-only, idempotent, and open-world annotations are preserved. `get-feedback-thread` remains non-read-only because it records an offered receipt; its operation is still non-destructive.

Real MCP-client discovery tests cover public collection submission and protected collection, conversation, and operator tools. All 12 focused feedback tests passed, followed by full qualification and the exact-source Quality, Release, and Publish gates. Authorization and persistence behavior are unchanged.

Upgrade `@emseepea/feedback` to 0.8.2. Closing this as completed.
comments.151:
Released in [@emseepea/testing 0.21.6](https://github.com/emseepea/emseepea/releases/tag/%40emseepea%2Ftesting%400.21.6), with all eleven `@emseepea/create-*` initializers updated to 0.1.8.

The direct MCP client dependency is now 2.2.0, including its required client-side core 2.2.0. The framework server SDK and its core remain at 2.0.0. The regenerated lockfile contains only client 2.2.0, and the semantic CLI checks and records that version. Starter development checks use the patched testing package; starters with a direct client dependency also pin 2.2.0.

All 60 testing-package tests passed. Full qualification and exact-source Quality, Release, and Publish passed, including existing public/protected protocol and credential-isolation checks and fresh initializer installation checks. npm audit no longer reports the MCP client advisory; this does not claim that all unrelated dependency advisories are absent.

Upgrade `@emseepea/testing` to 0.21.6 and any separately installed `@modelcontextprotocol/client` to a patched version. There is no demonstrated Em See Pea credential leak in the evidence reviewed. Closing this as completed.
